correctness.rationale: All unary operators are discrete one-Lipschitz maps by nonexpansive closure and finite McShane representation. An idempotent map fixes precisely an interval image, yielding independent left and right bounded lazy walks. Exact matrix enumeration follows. The uniform boundary eigenvector lower bound \(q_d\ge8/(d+2)^3\) and spectral norm upper bound reduce the logarithm to a one-dimensional variable-width Perron optimization. The small-angle expansion gives the unique cube-root optimum and sharp coefficient; uniform polynomial errors yield width concentration. A separate increment-walk argument controls all nonexpansive maps. Exact finite brute-force and dynamic programming checks passed; their limitations are explicit.

value.rationale: The idempotents of unary truth-value maps form the natural stable projection operators for a non-expansive fuzzy propositional base. The exact formula covers every chain granularity, while the sharp stretched-exponential rarity and cube-root image law provide a structural explanation unavailable from the total-monoid count. This is a natural complete all-size classification with asymptotic mechanism, not an arbitrary isolated numerical observation.
